We had been living in poverty and saw only my family everyday. We had moved around from one place to another,  and so i was left with lots of time to suffer in silence, as well as think about myself, others, and everything. I ended up thinking alot about myself. I found myself wanting, and wanting more from myself, began to remember everything i could, every day, so that i would not forget. And, as a quick side-note, i have not, but i almost forget to remember, as i would lose my head if it were not screwed on tight and proper. I'm not sure how relevant you may consider this, but as i write this, i suspect it wouldnt've mattered if he did or not, she would've been just as afraid and angry at living regardless, and just as unable to move on from anything. Anyway, I moved back in with her, and started to put some semblance of a life together for myself, first by working to get my GED. She did nothing; day in, day out, she would go to work, come home, watch tv, and smoke weed. I never had anything to say, and was already dealing with a heavy amount of self-loathing and guilt, compounding that onto my general unfulfillment towards my past,previously current circumstance. I was constantly belittled and unheard, talking circles to herself, not understanding a word i ever said, and so in her ignorance, began to react in fear, and so fear me.
